effect.skycraft.sanies_lupinus.desc: Stage 1 incubating lycanthropy contracted from a werewolf. Curable by Cure Disease potions, shrines, or healers before the third night.
curse.skycraft.sanguinare.day1: You feel weak in the light of day, and the nights call to you.
curse.skycraft.sanguinare.day2: Your heart beats slower. The sun burns your eyes. The disease is nearly done with you.
curse.skycraft.vampire.turned.sub: Sanguinare Vampiris has run its course. Feed on the sleeping, or the hunger will grow.
curse.skycraft.vampire.stage4: Your hunger shows on your face. Townsfolk will attack you on sight.
curse.skycraft.lord.granted.sub: Harkon's gift: the Vampire Lord form is among your powers.
curse.skycraft.lord.transformed: You become a Vampire Lord. Jump twice to levitate; sneak and use your Voice to return.
curse.skycraft.lord.no_corpse: There is no body there to raise.
curse.skycraft.lord.too_strong: They fight too hard. Weaken them first, or catch them unaware.
curse.skycraft.beast.granted.sub: %s is among your powers: once a day, become the wolf.
curse.skycraft.beast.transformed: The beast takes you. Feed on the dead to stay in this form.
curse.skycraft.beast.reverted: The beast recedes, and you are yourself again.
curse.skycraft.beast.fed: You feed. The hunt goes on a little longer.
curse.skycraft.beast.cannot_feed: The beast wants better prey than this.
curse.skycraft.beast.no_rest: The beast in your blood allows you no rest.
curse.skycraft.sight.on: Vampire's Sight: the night is clear to you.
curse.skycraft.howl.predator: You smell every living thing around you.
curse.skycraft.power.beast_form.desc: Become a werewolf for two and a half minutes. Feeding on corpses extends the transformation. Being seen changing is a crime, and everyone will attack you.
curse.skycraft.power.vampire_lord.desc: Become a Vampire Lord: claws and bites on the ground, Drain Life and night spells while levitating. Sneak and use your Voice to return to mortal form.
curse.skycraft.power.vampires_sight.desc: Improved night vision. Use again to end it.
curse.skycraft.power.vampires_servant.de: A dead thrall fights for you for 60 seconds; the hungrier you are, the stronger it is.
Invisibility and night vision for three minutes (four when Blood-Starved).
curse.skycraft.power.howl_of_terror.desc: Enemies nearby flee in terror for 15 seconds.
curse.skycraft.power.totem_of_ice_brothe: Two ice wolves answer your call and fight beside you for a minute.
curse.skycraft.power.totem_of_the_moon.d: Two werewolves answer your call and hunt beside you for a minute.
curse.skycraft.power.totem_of_the_predat: Smell every living creature around you for 30 seconds.
curse.skycraft.power.raise_dead.desc: Raise the body you're looking at to fight for you for 60 seconds.
curse.skycraft.power.vampiric_grip.desc: Pull a foe through the air to you, staggered and hurt.
curse.skycraft.power.corpse_curse.desc: Paralyze a foe for 8 seconds while its life withers.
curse.skycraft.power.bats.desc: Burst into a swarm of bats and reform a short way ahead.
curse.skycraft.power.mist_form.desc: Become mist for 8 seconds: unseen, untouchable, healing.
curse.skycraft.power.detect_life.desc: See every living creature nearby, even through walls, for 30 seconds.
curse.skycraft.power.summon_gargoyle.des: A gargoyle tears itself out of the ground to fight for you for two minutes.
curse.skycraft.power.night_cloak.desc: A cloak of bats for a minute: it bites foes close by and feeds you what it drinks.
curse.skycraft.tree.status: Perks to spend: %s    Feedings: %s (next perk at %s)
curse.skycraft.tree.hint: Feed to earn perks. Click a lit star to take it. Esc to close.
curse.skycraft.perk.earned: A new %s perk is yours to take (Skills).
curse.skycraft.perk.bestial_strength.des: Your claws do 25% more damage in Beast Form, per rank.
curse.skycraft.perk.animal_vigor.desc: 50 more Health and Stamina in Beast Form.
curse.skycraft.perk.thick_hide.desc: Your hide turns more blows in Beast Form.
curse.skycraft.perk.savage_feeding.desc: Feed on beasts as well as people.
curse.skycraft.perk.hircines_favor.desc: Beast Form lasts half again as long.
curse.skycraft.perk.totem_of_terror.desc: Howl of Terror reaches farther, lasts twice as long and frightens the strongest foes.
curse.skycraft.perk.totem_of_the_predato: A new howl: smell every living creature nearby.
curse.skycraft.perk.totem_of_ice_brother: A new howl: two ice wolves fight beside you.
curse.skycraft.perk.totem_of_the_moon.de: A new howl: two werewolves answer your call.
curse.skycraft.perk.blood_frenzy.desc: Claws hit harder against the wounded, and every person you kill keeps you in Beast Form 10 seconds longer.
curse.skycraft.perk.power_of_the_grave.d: 50 more Health, Magicka and Stamina in Vampire Lord form.
curse.skycraft.perk.detect_life.desc: A new night power: see the living through walls.
curse.skycraft.perk.mist_form.desc: A new night power: become untouchable mist for a moment.
curse.skycraft.perk.supernatural_reflexe: A new night power: the world slows around you.
curse.skycraft.perk.blood_healing.desc: Feeding as a Vampire Lord heals half your Health.
curse.skycraft.perk.unearthly_will.desc: Vampire Lord spells cost a third less Magicka.
curse.skycraft.perk.vampiric_grip.desc: A new night spell: pull foes to you through the air.
curse.skycraft.perk.poison_talons.desc: Your claws poison what they cut.
curse.skycraft.perk.night_cloak.desc: A new night power: a cloak of biting bats.
curse.skycraft.perk.corpse_curse.desc: A new night spell: paralyze a foe while its life withers.
curse.skycraft.perk.summon_gargoyle.desc: A new night power: call a gargoyle to your side.
curse.skycraft.menu.hint: Click to equip. Sneak and use your Voice to return to mortal form.
